increment_paragraph: **LERI-HELD-FORMAL-LINK-OBLIGATION** (exit-class precondition; user decision 2026-11-27: a contract schema field; gateway rule 91 amended in place with part (5), contract specification §C04.8 amended, Lean `QCore.ExitClassLinkPrecondition`; [report](../../reports/leri-held-exit-class-precondition/README.md)). A new field, `ResourceFunctionContract::link_preconditions` (declared `requires resource_links_valid(p, MEMBER)` at an owned, consumed or released pointer position), states rule 91's entry obligation (the caller owes `p`'s `MEMBER` links valid on entry) without the unlink. The body seeds an `Owed` record, admitted and forgotten as `Ready`; a precondition-only formal released through the carried destroyer reads `Mixed`. W4 attaches it, after rule 91's candidate failed, at each carried formal bound but not released, so rule 11r's exit-specific route summarises a body that destroys its formal on one exit class (an element destroyer) and stores or keeps it on another (`Consumed`/`Owned` beside the precondition), publishing only when every class states the same entry obligations; each caller checks it on every class before the call (its published object, its own initialisation of the member, or its own formal carried; anything else, a foreign element included, refuses), and `has_container_effect` counts it so every unaware consumer refuses. Fixtures: the enqueue shape, a kept variant, a never-returning destroy path and two callers Unknown → Safe; every other caller refuses at a named leaf. Measured base `0956f4d21` against tip `9a6a85c71` on the fluent-bit-system route and the census units it does not read (this host's 046accf6 preparation): 116/0/327/5 and 34/1/165/0 on both sides, no row moved and no leaf changed, null property unchanged. The prediction (`flb_output_task_queue_enqueue` Unknown → Safe) was wrong: its failure path calls `flb_errno()` before the destroyer, and rule 46's kill policy reads that call (a nested `__errno_location()` and a non-name actual) as reaching every object, so the carried record dies first; every other census row is blocked earlier (unmodelled member stores, uncontracted calls, `flb_tail_file_remove`'s contract-pin mismatch).

ledger.text: AMENDED by LERI-HELD-FORMAL-LINK-OBLIGATION (exit-class precondition; gateway rule 91 (5), Lean QCore.ExitClassLinkPrecondition, base 0956f4d21): the precondition-only clause exists as a schema field, ResourceFunctionContract::link_preconditions (declared requires resource_links_valid(p, MEMBER)); its body side (an Owed record; a release through the carried destroyer reads Mixed), W4 side (attached after rule 91's candidate fails, per exit class through rule 11r, classes must agree on entry obligations) and caller side (checked before the call on every class: published, own initialisation, own formal carried; foreign elements and everything else refuse; unaware consumers refuse through has_container_effect) are discharged, with fixtures (the enqueue shape and its callers Unknown -> Safe) and Lean parity. Measured at 0956f4d21 against 9a6a85c71 on the fluent-bit-system route and the census units (flb_input.c, in_tail): no row moved. REMAINING: no census row reaches its destroyer with the carried record alive. flb_output_task_queue_enqueue: flb_errno() (flb_errno_print(*__errno_location(), __FILE__, __LINE__)) precedes flb_task_retry_destroy, and rule 46's kill policy reads a call with a nested call or a non-name actual as reaching every object. flb_output_net_property_check and three flb_input_*_property_check: an unmodelled store into ins before the destroyer; flb_input_plugin_property_check: uncontracted calls, indirect accesses and a member store through ins; flb_output_enable_multi_threading: the uncontracted flb_output_thread_pool_create(config, ins) in the branch condition; flb_task_retry_reschedule and flb_engine_dispatch_retry: uncontracted calls and refuted callees; in_tail check_purge_deleted_file and reconcile_file_state: flb_tail_file_remove's pinned contract is not in force (contract-pin-mismatch). DISCHARGE (nearest): a kill-policy refinement for a contracted call whose non-name actuals and nested calls provably hand no pointer to the object (a scalar read through __errno_location(), literals), with Lean parity; the other rows need their own leaves first.
